name: manual_252848
claim: A provisional correction removes a lesson from structured recall because recall.py takes only the latest row per lesson id and skips non-accepted rows. After correcting a lesson that must stay recallable, end the chain with an accepted superseding lesson (learn.py --stage-only, then graduate.py --supersedes), and confirm with recall.py --quiet that it is returned. Run recall with --quiet when checking, because a plain run appends a proactive-recall row to the episodic log.

decisions.notes: Supersedes lesson_80f7b1d8d9a3. Reaffirms the append-only superseding graduation procedure and verifies recallability of the Phase 1B bounded-launcher lessons.
